name: v2.81.0
body:
## What's Changed

### ✨ Features & Platform Support

* Allow custom templates to override `search.min.js` in the modern template by @filzrev in [#10055](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/10055).
* Add `metadata.sourceLinkExclude` to exclude selected source paths from **View Source** links without removing API documentation by @vicancy in [#11141](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11141).
* Record the DocFX build version in the `docfx_version` field of `manifest.json` by @vicancy in [#11162](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11162).
* Add a .NET 11 RC target, including support for the .NET 11 Razor source generator, while retaining .NET 8, 9, and 10 targets by @vicancy and @filzrev in [#11176](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11176) and [#11182](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11182).

### ⚡ Performance & Reliability

* Reduce JavaScript template processing overhead and memory allocations by reusing parsed scripts and improving model conversion. Add execution limits to prevent runaway scripts from hanging builds by @lahma in [#11084](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11084).
* Avoid unnecessary exceptions and repeated file reads when loading `toc.yml` by @filzrev in [#9974](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/9974).

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Restore source links for partial types extended by source generators by @vicancy in [#11141](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11141).
* Fix local namespace links in managed reference documentation by resolving them through xrefs during site generation by @vicancy in [#11163](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11163).
* Preserve nested XML blocks when inserting Markdown separators, preventing content from incorrectly rendering as code blocks by @vicancy in [#11175](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11175).
* Preserve explicit `false` and `0` values when overwriting nullable properties by @vicancy in [#11181](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11181).

### 📦 Dependency Updates

* Update Jint to **4.16.3** in [#11157](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11157).
* Update Markdig to **1.4.0** in [#11158](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11158) and [#11160](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11160).
* Update YamlDotNet to **18.1.0** in [#11167](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11167).
* Update PdfPig to **0.1.16** in [#11168](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11168).
* Update ICSharpCode.Decompiler to **11.1.0.9782** in [#11184](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11184).
* Update System.Composition to **10.0.12** in [#11165](https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/pull/11165).

### Upgrade Notes

Custom JavaScript template preprocessors now enforce a **30-second timeout** and a **50-million-statement limit** for each `getOptions` or `transform` invocation. Long-running custom scripts may need adjustment.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dotnet/docfx/compare/v2.80.1...v2.81.0
